LESSON: HEALING OF THE PARALYTIC

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Miracles of Jesus Christ
Topic 3.3: Healing of the Paralytic
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 7

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Healing of the Paralytic, part of Miracles of Jesus Christ in Grade 8 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: when God answered their prayers. • read, write on flashcards and meditate on Isaiah 53:4-5. How does the healing of the paralytic build your faith in God?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. brainstorm on the meaning of the word, paralysis,

2. read and discuss Luke 5:17-26 and make a presentation in class using charts, posters or Power Point slides,

3. discuss lessons learnt from the healing of the paralytic and make notes,

4. watch a movie on the healing of the paralytic,

6. brainstorm on reasons

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. brainstorm on the meaning of the word, paralysis,
2. read and discuss Luke 5:17-26 and make a presentation in class using charts, posters or Power Point slides,
3. discuss lessons learnt from the healing of the paralytic and make notes,
4. watch a movie on the healing of the paralytic,
5. buzz on the meaning of the word, blasphemy,
6. brainstorm on reasons

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Healing of the Paralytic together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Digital literacy: The skill of using digital learning platforms is enhanced as learners watch a movie on the healing of the

paralytic.

• Self-efficacy: The skill of self-awareness is portrayed as learners write a personal reflection journal on occasions when God

answered their prayers.

Values:
• Respect: The learners take turns as they discuss and brainstorm on various activities.

• Unity: The learners work in groups as they discuss, read various Bible texts and watch a movie on the healing of the

paralytic.

Link to other subjects:

• Integrated Science: The learners brainstorm on the meaning of paralysis.

• English: The learners read various Bible texts and make presentations in class.
